title: SourceReference
description: How a piece of data is cited. Every DataRecord MUST have a source_ref. This is the foundation of provenance.

source_url.description: Direct URL to the source page or API endpoint. REQUIRED for web_page, pdf, database types.

source_doi.description: DOI of the source publication, if applicable. e.g. '10.1234/abc.5678'.

source_pmid.description: PubMed ID, if the source is a PubMed article.

source_accession.description: Database accession. e.g. 'GSE12345' for GEO, '1AKI' for PDB, 'hsa04150' for KEGG pathway.

query.description: The exact query string or API parameters used to retrieve this data. Critical for reproducibility.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the data was retrieved.

raw_payload_path.description: Optional. Relative path to the cached raw API response or downloaded file, e.g. 'cache/pubmed_a1b2c3d4.json'.
